statement: Main goal is to max out all merit shop bonuses but beginners cannot max everything so the tier list is a generalization
Inventory bag merit is F tier since you get the bags anyway from easy quest lines
World 1 mob respawn is top A or near S and usually a priority; more kills and loot and helps characters without respawn abilities
In early game you will not see the potency of mob respawn because it costs a lot of merit points especially in world 1
4% XP for lowest level character is F tier because it seems additive and with vault it is not good
Creator checks that his lowest level character is 600 and the bonus seems multiplicative; unsure if merit or vault bonus causes it
If additive it is F tier and if multiplicative it goes B or A; old W1 merit suggests additive; vault baby on board may be why
Hemoglobin is S tier and best merit; always aim for it first because without it you need healing food (only shaman has healing otherwise)
Boss key drop merit is B or A tier; it affects cheese and amarok keys and other keys; early game it is better
Boss key merit is the only one letting all keys drop; cheese keys farmable via dilapidated slush while amarok keys are not; late game maxed anyway
Amarok gear is S tier budget and speedrun gear used until almost world 6; first three pieces are A tier
Amarok helmet and pendant are very expensive so not worth going for; only first three pieces worth getting before replacing them
W1 miniboss star talent merit is A tier at one point but drops to B tier when buying multiples; frothy milk and postage stamp
Dr Death and Baba Yaga will not drop talent books unless you have at least one point in this merit
W2 merit for more orb? drops is big S since it unlocks full mechanics and you need orbs for 10 characters
W2 mob respawn same spot as W1; W1 better because gmush kills and multi-kill tiers
2% AFK gains for first nine characters is old and not very good now
2% AFK gains is C tier and only makes a difference maybe in world 1 and 2
XP converter max level merit is trash; do not spend points on it even with abundant points
World boss gem drop merit is triple S and better than hemoglobin; unlocks ability to farm gems with daily bosses unless you are a whale
Skip efaunt armor set completely; drop rate helmet needs resources you lack early
Efaunt helmet needs killing Doot and 3D eyes with 5% drop rate; creator says tier not based on slab
W2 miniboss star talent merit is B tier; pulsation good early and cardiovascular a must if guard farming; good for one point only
Arcade ball gain 25% is B tier; not that good
Arcade ball gain only saves around 20 minutes and most people cap balls before checking anyway
Build and food slots merit is easy S tier; purchases 1 and 3 give build slot and 2 and 4 give food slots; mid to bottom of S behind hemoglobin
Extra food slots allow more golden defense weapon power and healing food; build slots help building towers and shrines through end game
W3 mob respawn ahead of W2 but not W1 because of gmush farming
Plus 10 max library talent books merit is high priority as max talents mean more damage and skills; maybe before orbs
Telekinetic storage star talent is mid and top of C; only 13.6% carry capacity at 50 points and pets made it weaker
Telekinetic storage can be used actively to put items into storage but destroys everything on the ground
Telekinetic storage is more useful if you lack ram companion; creator would put it before arcade balls
Upgrade vault lets you deposit to storage from AFK which makes telekinetic storage even more redundant
Printer sample size merit is A tier; helps keep royal sampler low to avoid XP reduction and get 90% from printer sooner
Refinery salt merit is S tier; powering up salts is amazing and you will have enough salts to never worry again
World 3 boss armor is S tier just for caustic scarf; next budget build before troll armor
Without the cheese scarf you cannot get the divine scarf which is best in slot necklace; this is amarok gear on steroids
First kill each day crystal spawn merit is F tier; three crystals will not make or break a day
W4 mob respawn goes above W3 and W2; top of B; elite classes like beast master and siege breaker rely on respawn
Nesting egg capacity is B tier; expensive but you want max capacity for breeding XP and few merit alternatives
Spice village star talent is B tier going by chat; converter pet exists; creator unsure and untested
Lab connection range merit is low A below printer; it is node to character range that does not level in lab
Troll armor is S tier right behind hemoglobin and the baseline for world 4 5 6 gear after initially joking F tier
Troll armor is heavily salt locked but can skip earlier armors; troll to magma cheap magma to croc pretty cheap then marble gets expensive
No bubble left behind merit is used in most account reviews and is great for alchemy
No bubble left behind caps at bubble level 1500 so does not beat farming free blue gems daily
Plus 3 talent points for tab four is low C or top F since leveling is easy with vault and alchemy
W5 mob respawn is A tier; question whether it affects hole and siege breaker plunderers mob kills
Loot pile capacity is mid B one above eggs; caps at around 29 so maxing is partly redundant
Stat overload star talent is C tier and better than telekinetic storage; total stat not affected by all stat percent
Stat overload gives total stat not base stat so all stat percent does not affect it; some need it for damage and accuracy
5% XP for sailing divinity and gaming is low A mainly due to hard-to-get divinity XP
Skill XP merit is interchangeable with connection range; gaming XP unimportant and sailing XP abundant
Croc armor is F tier and slightly above troll; chest and legs best in slot for beast master
Divine scarf needs croc armor; croc and troll are interchangeable since you need both
Atom upgrade cost reduction is B tier and situational; useless early but good once printing many atoms; last W5 merit to buy
Atom reduction is mainly used for power upscaling; neon is upgraded last in the atom collider
Plus 2 talent points for tab five is expensive; master classes are not affected by alchemy talent points
Tab five talent points got buffed to 100 for 20 points; bottom A tier but not S until all master classes release
W6 spirited valley mob respawn is only 10% so gmush W1 is still on top
Farming merit first three purchases giving land plots are S tier and the rest is poor; overall A tier
Jade gain 3% merit is high A or S since sneaking is slow; worse than first three land plots but better than the rest
Land plots and jade rank above the 10% W6 respawn merit but not above overall mob respawn for all worlds
Summoning winner bonus merit is S tier and should be bought right away; creator corrected to 10% max
Early winner bonuses are strong (1.28x total damage first win); first one to max in W6 and an insta buy
World 6 boss emperor armor is unknown and predicted to be better than godshard; buy troll then croc then godshard then emperor
Each world has independent merit points; tier list is opinionated and shows what to prioritize per world
